projects.title: Projects
projects.heading: Selected work: client sites and projects of my own.

nerva-studio.outcome: Fashion e-commerce, end to end: shop with dynamic filters, working cart and checkout, and a full admin dashboard.

quintana.outcome: Prestige furniture e-commerce: gallery-grade product presentation for pieces that sell on craft.

rocketly.outcome: Software studio site: services, vision and technical credibility for a team that ships.

void-strikers.outcome: In-house 2D action game: proof that I build interactive things, not just pages.

lol-champions.outcome: Data-heavy app: advanced filtering and video-rich detail views over a live game catalog.

services.title: Services
services.heading: Nearly everything I build is one of three shapes.
services.lead: Fixed scope, honest timeline, built to last.

landing.title: Landing Pages
landing.lead: A single page built to do one thing: turn the visitor in front of it into a lead or a sale.
included: Everything points at one call to action
Loads in under a second on any phone
Analytics and tracking wired in from day one

events.title: Event Websites
events.lead: One link that carries the event, from the first save-the-date to the morning of.
included: RSVPs and the guest list, handled on the site
Schedule, directions and updates in one place

professional.title: Professional Websites
professional.lead: The complete site for a name that has to look established from the very first screen.
included: Designed around your identity, never a template
Search-ready, and bilingual when you need it

about.title: About
about.heading: You're working directly with the person who writes the code.
lead: I'm Juan Pablo Cuadrelli, and this is a one-person studio.
You talk to the developer building your site, not an account manager passing messages along.
The work is for businesses that need to look established from the first screen.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heading: Tell me what you're building.
